generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders The departments shall not be responsible for non accessibility of KPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder
Conditional / Incomplete Tenders are liable to be rejected .The Employer reserves the right to Reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason

Tenderer shall note that the Tenders of those found Eligible as mentioned in Clause 3 Qualification of the Tenderer in Section 2 Instructions to Tenderers (ITT), will only be considered for evaluation

The quoted cost shall include royalty applicable by central/state/local authorities. Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders. Royalty shall be deducted as per KMMCR 1994 Amendment rule 2016, Also KMMCR 2016 Amendment Rule 36(3), 42(1), 44(3), 44(4)
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable

The successful bidder, before commencement of work shall produce Establishment registration certificate registered under labour department, Government of Karnataka . And shall engage only registered construction workers registered under labour department, Government of Karnataka

As per Karnataka State Govt Order No:LD/300/LET/2006/Bangalore Dt: 1-1-2007 and Govt Ltr No:PW/134/BMS/2007, Dt: 27-7-2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund.
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27 in the Technical Qualification Criteria .
Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) from Practicing Chartered Account is Preferred with Annual Turnover certificate, P&L statements and in a Balance Sheets.

During the execution of work, if any minor minerals are required contractors have to abide by the Karnataka Minor Mineral Concession Rules 1994 (as amended up to date). As per the prevailing rules, for any use of Minor Minerals, the contractor has to submit the Mineral Dispatch Permit (MDP) obtained from Mines and Geology Department. If Mineral Dispatch Permit (MDP) is not submitted by the contractor along with the bill, the prevailing penalty and DMF contribution as per Karnataka Minor Mineral concession rules 1994 (as amended from time to time) will be deducted from contractors bills at the time of payment.
Sub-Leasing/G.P.A of Work is Prohibited.

The contractor has to furnish Additional Performance Security Deposit for unbalance tender as per clause 29.1 of ITT, to an amount equal to the difference in contract price and amount put to tender, in addition to 5% performance guarantee (in any of the form prescribed) while concluding the Agreement, .Failure of the successful tenderer to comply with the requirements of Tender clauses shall constitute a sufficient grounds for cancellations of the award and forfeiture of the Earnest Money Deposit
The contractor have been registered as KPWD class-III & Above Registration Certificate (upload registration certificate of original should be produced while opening the tender)
Line of Credit (LOC) or Bankers Certificate (BC) should be in prescribed format (On Banks Letter Head), if not, then the Bid is liable to be rejected
Addendum / Corrigendum will be published on the website for all modifications or corrections, if any.
The period of completion is 09 (Nine months) including monsoon.

The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work, and make themselves familiar with the local situation regarding the availability of the construction materials, workmen, land required for construction activities, etc.
The defects liability period is 1(ONE) year, i.e during the warranty period.

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and compete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work.
Financial Year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty first day of March of succeeding year (both days inclusive).
The tenderer shall furnish required information in all formats. Scan and upload all Formats/Original documents required for this bid to the KPP Portal.
The Agency shall comply with ISO14001 (Environmental Management System) requirement during execution of work.
The Tenders are invited as per Standard tender Bid Document KW-4

Agencies participating in the tender shall be registered in the Construction Labour Board as per the G.O.No.LD 300 LET 2006 Dated:18-1-2007 and Addendum No.LD 95 LET 2013 Bengaluru Dt:1-4-2013. Also the contractors entrusted with the work shall employ the labours only who have registered in the Karnataka Building and Construction Workers Welfare Board failing which the contractor shall be liable for any further action as deem fit by the authority/ EPF Registration
Omission and Typographical errors which are in the opinion of the Executive Engineer will not be a ground for claims of extra payment
Item for which 0.00 rate entered will not be paid for by the employer when executed and shall be deemed covered by the other rates & prices in the bill of quantities

Contractor has to make his own arrangement at his cost for procurement of all materials required for the work. There is no departmental supply of materials. Contractor should procure ONLY ISI mark materials and submit necessary quality control certificates from the authorized quality control authority, before execution.
If any of the dates mentioned in this tender happens to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good.

Contractors have to upload the Certificates of works in hand of any Department/Institutions failing which the tender will not be considered. Action will be taken as per clause 31 of SECTION 2: INSTRUCTIONS TO TENDERERS (ITT) in case of incomplete/ false documents regarding works in hand
Uploaded drawings are for TENDER PURPOSE ONLY
Restriction of public procurement from bidders of certain countries as in order number:-FD/455/EXP-12/2020/BENGALURU/Dated:01-04-2023.
The star rates in respect of specified materials (Cement, Steel and Bitumen) shall be payable as per GO No: FD/3/PCL/2008 Bangalore Dated 21.11.2008 and G.O No: PWD 159 CRM dtd: 30-09-2010.
Name, address, telephone, email id and fax numbers of the contractor is to be provided for communication.

The Tenderer has quote his rate by excluding GST.However Contract will be concluded for the amount (Exclusive of GST) but applicable GST will be paid extra prevailing at the time of execution.If the GST Rates are revised during the contract period, the Tenderer/Employer has to accept the revised GST rates for making payment / recovery.

technicalCriterionList.description: 3.6 Tenderers who meet the specified minimum qualifying criteria will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under: Assessed available tender capacity (AxNx1.5-B), Where A is Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years i.e.2021-22 to 2025-26 (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N is Number of years (0.75 years) prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited. B is Value, at 2026-27price level, of existing commitments and ongoing works to be completed during the next 0.75 years (09 Calendar months) Note: The statements showing the value of existing commitments and ongoing works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent.
